先写清楚三件事：要开车，还是只要一张身份证明？现有驾照是哪里发的？要办哪一种卡？: Write down three things first: do you need to drive, or just an ID? Where was your current license issued? Which card do you want? Keeping these apart stops you from walking to the wrong window with a friend's old checklist. This guide is for adults; minors follow DMV's age and training rules.
DMV 写明：ID 只证明身份或年龄，不能用来开车。2025 年 5 月 7 日: DMV says an ID card proves identity or age but does not let you drive. Since May 7, 2025, boarding a domestic flight or entering some federal facilities takes a federally compliant card such as a passport, military ID or REAL ID. If you only need ID, compare a standard ID with a REAL ID; if you need to drive, follow the license process. A REAL ID does not skip the license tests.
从没有任何州或国家的驾照：先办学习许可（instruction permit），: Never licensed in any state or country: get an instruction permit first, practice once you pass the knowledge test, then book the drive test when ready.
有效的美国其他州驾照：走外州换证流程，交申请和身份、住址材料，考视力和笔试。: A valid license from another U.S. state: use the out-of-state process, with the application, identity and residency documents, a vision test and a knowledge test.
外国驾照：按外州驾照的流程申请，另外要通过路考；外国驾照不能直接换成加州驾照。: A foreign license: apply the same way as an out-of-state license and also pass a drive test; a foreign license cannot simply be exchanged.
只办 ID：按 ID 页面到 DMV 核验身份、拍照，不用考驾驶。: ID only: follow the ID page, verify your identity and take a photo at DMV; no driving test.
首次申请：费用、预约和笔试: First application: fee, appointment and knowledge test
DMV 写明：首次申请 C 类驾照（普通小汽车）的申请费是 $46，交费后申请: DMV says a first Class C (passenger car) license costs $46, and the application and fee are valid for 12 months. You can start the application online, then book a DMV office visit for a thumbprint, vision test, photo and knowledge test. The test is multiple choice from the California Driver's Handbook, and 80% passes; you get up to 3 tries per test, and after 3 fails you reapply. DMV does not start knowledge tests after 4:30 p.m.
DMV 有中文版加州驾驶手册和中文 C 类笔试练习题。DMV 写明现场笔试要预约: DMV publishes the California Driver's Handbook in Chinese and Class C practice tests in Chinese. DMV says the in-person knowledge test needs an appointment and is offered in English and many other languages; taking it in another language adds a traffic signs test. Say you want to test in Chinese when you book.
选择语言“中文”下载 PDF。: Pick "Chinese" in the language list to download the PDF.

新居民：驾照的 10 天和车辆登记的 20 天: New residents: 10 days for the license, 20 days for the car
加州车辆法 12505(c) 规定：原本凭外州驾照合法开车的人，成为加州居民后，: California Vehicle Code 12505(c): if you were driving legally on an out-of-state license, you may keep driving on it for at most 10 days after becoming a California resident; if you are hired to drive after becoming a resident, you need a California license first. Residency depends on whether you have settled here, not simply the day you arrived; if unsure, start your California application right away.
DMV 新居民页面要求：把外州登记的自用车带进加州的新居民，在成为居民或把车带进: DMV's new-resident page says new residents who bring a car registered elsewhere must register it in California within 20 days of becoming a resident or bringing the car in; don't wait for your California license. Prepare REG 343 signed by the owner, the out-of-state title or registration, a REG 31 vehicle verification by an authorized person, a smog check where required, and keep proof of insurance in the car.
DMV 新居民页面和登记材料。: DMV's new-resident page and registration documents.
已有加州 DMV 记录的人搬家，地址变了 10 天内要通知 DMV，可以在网上改: If you already have a California DMV record and move, tell DMV within 10 days; you can do it online. Tick both the license and the vehicles to update both, and note that changing the address does not mail a new card. If you have no California license or ID yet, just put the right address on your first application.

已有加州记录的人用；处理最多约 3 天。: For people with a California record; takes up to about 3 days.
REAL ID 要带一份身份文件原件或认证副本（改过名的加带衔接证明），再加两份: A REAL ID takes one identity document, original or certified copy (plus the linking document if your name changed), and two different residency documents with your name and California address; build your own list with DMV's interactive REAL ID checklist. A standard (non-REAL ID) license needs only one accepted residency document. If a bill is not in your name, the checklist explains which family-relationship proof works; a roommate's bill does not.
AB 60 是给无法证明在美合法居留、但能证明身份和加州住址的人的另一种驾照，不: AB 60 is a separate license for people who cannot prove lawful presence but can prove identity and California residency; it is not a REAL ID. Prepare documents from DMV's AB 60 page; give passports, SSNs and immigration papers only to DMV, never to strangers in a public post.
业务类型选对：首次申请、换州、外国驾照、ID，还是续期、补证。: Pick the right service: first application, out-of-state transfer, foreign license, ID, renewal or replacement.
预约确认信息、地点和业务类型一致。: The confirmation, office and service type match.
身份和住址材料符合所选卡种的清单，姓名拼写、门牌号和邮寄地址一致。: Identity and residency documents fit the checklist for your card, with the same name spelling, unit number and mailing address.
笔试用 DMV 驾驶手册准备，可以先做中文练习题；想用中文考，预约时说明。: Study the DMV handbook and try the Chinese practice tests; say you want a Chinese test when you book.
路考另外预约；考试用车要通过 DMV 的车辆安全检查。: Book the drive test separately; the test car must pass DMV's pre-drive safety check.
需要语言或无障碍协助，提前问 DMV。: Ask DMV ahead for language or accessibility help.

湾区很多租房纠纷不是出在合同太复杂，而是出在钱转得太早。没看房、没核实身份、没拿: Many Bay Area rental disputes start not with a complicated lease but with money sent too early. Until you have seen the place, verified who you are dealing with and have it in writing, don't send Zelle, Cash App, Venmo or other payments that are hard to recover. If they want money in a personal account and push you to pay on the spot, stop.
加州司法部写明：2024 年 7 月 1 日以后，多数房东收的押金最多一个月房租: The California Attorney General says that after July 1, 2024, most landlords may take a deposit of at most one month's rent. If someone asks for two or three months, ask on what basis; within 21 days of move-out the landlord must return the deposit with an itemized list of deductions.
问清没租成时这笔钱退不退、怎么退，要书面说明。: Ask in writing whether and how the money comes back if the rental falls through.
很多人抢房时只看月租和入住日期，后来才发现停车、清洁、续租、提前搬走、加室友都有: In a rush, many people look only at the rent and move-in date and later find limits on parking, cleaning, renewal, leaving early or adding a roommate. Before signing, settle the costs, term, repairs, subletting and move-out rules, and get the deposit, application fee and early-termination terms into the lease.

社安号（SSN）：办移民签证时在 DS-260 表上勾选申请社安卡的人，SSA: Social Security number (SSN): if you asked for a card on the DS-260 with your immigrant visa, SSA mails it to your U.S. address; if it hasn't arrived 3 weeks after you were admitted, take proof of age, identity and work authorization to the nearest SSA office or Card Center. Others in the U.S. can start online on SSA's website, then bring documents to an SSA office; once approved, the card arrives by mail in 5 to 10 business days. Noncitizens need work, school or another valid reason to get a number. SSA: 1-800-772-1213; ask for a Chinese interpreter.

正常流程是先看房或视频看房，再弄清出租人身份、房屋地址、费用、入住时间和合同内容: The normal order is to view the place in person or by video, then establish who the landlord is, the address, costs, move-in date and lease terms, and only then talk about payment. Be on guard if they push you to pay at once, say it goes to someone else unless you pay now, or never let you see the place itself.
把地址放到地图里看一遍：真有这栋房子，不是空地、办公楼或对不上的地方。: Look the address up on a map: the building exists and isn't an empty lot, an office or something that doesn't match.
看图片和租金合不合理；比同区便宜很多的，先问原因。: Do the photos and rent make sense? If it is much cheaper than the area, ask why first.
没法到场看房时，要求实时视频看房，只有预录视频或几张截图不够。: If you can't view in person, ask for a live video tour; a recorded video or a few screenshots is not enough.
先问清这笔钱是什么：申请费、holding deposit、押金，还是第一月房租: Ask what the money is: an application fee, a holding deposit, the security deposit or the first month's rent.
收款人姓名要和出租人身份对得上。: The payee's name must match the landlord's identity.
对方说自己在外州、国外、出差或钥匙托管，也照样核验。: Even if they say they are out of state, abroad, traveling or that someone else holds the keys, verify anyway.
